name: Metric Yang Obstruction
definition: For an ample family $H$ of order $m\ge2$, let $\mathscr O(H)$ be the order sphere. For each distance-two pair $D=\{u,v\}$, form the poset that places every common neighbour of $u,v$ below both endpoints, and let $\mathscr R_D^{\mathrm{met}}$ be the order complex of its proper order ideals. If $\mathscr U_{\mathrm{met}}(H)$ is the union of these subcomplexes, define $\omega_{\mathrm{met}}(H)=\dim_{\mathbb F_2}\widetilde H_{m-2}(\mathscr U_{\mathrm{met}}(H);\mathbb F_2)$.
normalization: Set $\omega_{\mathrm{met}}(H)=0$ for the one-concept ample family. For $m\ge2$, the degree is the top dimension $m-2$ of the order sphere and homology uses $\mathbb F_2$ coefficients.
comments: The definition uses only distance-two pairs and their common-neighbour sets in the concept graph. It equals one exactly when the family is not corner-peelable, so it is an exact recognition invariant rather than a generative parametrization.
